# Rajdhani Packaging

> Rajdhani Packaging (Rajdhani Print 'N' Pack) is a plastic pouch manufacturer in Delhi NCR, based in Khera Kalan Industrial Area, New Delhi. We make custom printed plastic pouches and bags for food, snacks, spices, seeds, flour, rice, tea, tubes and detergent powder brands, with factory pricing and delivery across Delhi NCR and India.

- Pouch types: stand-up pouches, zipper pouches, three-side seal pouches, spout pouches and laminated heat seal pouches.
- Customization: size, thickness, material, print design and finish (matte or glossy).
- Service area: Delhi, Noida, Greater Noida, Gurgaon, Ghaziabad, Faridabad and all of India.
- Contact: +91-9289691009, rajdhanipackaging8@gmail.com
- Address: 108/186, Khera Kalan, Industrial Area, Delhi-82 (Near Satyam Dharamkanta)
